name: @juli-os/basin
description: juli-os foundation: versioned SQLite migrations on node:sqlite — open connections, build schema, track versions. Zero npm dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/basin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/basin.js && chmod +x dist/basin.js && python3 scripts/postbuild.py
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(async m => { const { join } = await import('node:path'); const { tmpdir } = await import('node:os'); const db = m.openDatabase(join(tmpdir(), 'basin-dist-' + Date.now() + '.db')); const mg = m.sqlMigration(1, 'smoke', 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)'); const r = m.migrate(db, [mg]); if (r.to !== 1 || !m.verify(db, [mg]).upToDate) process.exit(1); console.log('DIST SMOKE OK'); })"
